reviews.comment: Personally i wasn't a huge fan of how he lectures, just because he made it seem wayyy more complicated than it actually is. He would also make a lot of mistakes on the exam, due to using AI to create the problems; which i guess for us is good because we get free points but still frustrating. Attendance isn't required, we have weekly homework.

Holt was awesome, super funny guy! I would say his lectures seem more complicated than what it actually is, he had past exams that we could use to study which is what i would use, and it would help the most. I'm taking him again for 202. Attendance isn't required but i believe he did iclicker for extra credit.

Holt is one of the kinder and more accommodating teachers in the physics department, imo. The content can be self-taught, and I would recommend learning mainly through YouTube videos because lectures can be confusing. The final exam was hard with a very low average; the other exams were fair. Use old exams to study.

I'll preface by saying he's clearly passionate. I felt that his lecturing style was a bit intense, which might be some people's style but not mine. I found recitation more helpful. Don't take the T/R block, you will never go to class. I stopped going after spring break and still did well, but I would've gone if it was MWF. Lengthy weekly homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: this class blows
This class blows. Rather my father never come back then to re do this course. Lots of EC.

People complain about 201 but I didn't think it was that hard. I didn't take physics in high school and didn't even go to class all that much but just do all the previous exams before exams and you should be ok. Lowkey a lot of homework but its way harder than anything on the tests.

The questions Holt writes on his exams are way more complicated than they need to be and you can tell when studying previous exams from past semesters. Ford's exams are very straightforward. Holt does offer extra credit and is very approachable for help. Take PHYS201 the fall when Ford writes the exams, could make a difference for your GPA.

I did well in the class when I took it in the Spring semester. TAKE IT IN THE FALL. I've heard stories of how the Fall Semester Exams are easier cause they are written by Ford. He should not be your first pick, take him unless you have to and take him in the Fall.

Holt is not a great lecturer BUT his exams are easy which makes up for it. He did have extra credit iClicker if you went to class but I never went. I would just review all his posted previous exams in the week leading up to the exam and I would do great. Don't bother spending too much time on the Mastering Physics; it's not similar to exams at all.

Taken Fall of 2025. His teaching style simply was not for me, so I did a lot of self-learning. Too symbol-heavy. If you take him in the Fall the midterms are departmental and written by Ford, so you're fine until the final, which will catch you off guard for it's difficulty. As for if you take 201 with him in the Spring, good luck. No Ford tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly I was wary of holt from his reviews, but pay no heed. Holt is an AMAZING physics 201 professor. This is not an easy class, so I highly recommend you go to all his lectures, but it is so much easier to want to go because he is funny and entertaining and explains concepts extremely well. Practice exams are so so helpful, so utilize them!

Does not lecture well and makes many mistakes on each test during the semester. Exams are NOTHING like the practice and worded differently. Watching videos to understand concepts helped more to improve your grade.

his teaching style was not for me and i did end up having to teach myself most of the content. took him in the spring when he was the only prof and he made lots of mistakes writing the exams, but offered extra credit because of it. funny guy, just not the greatest at teaching. use your resources and don't fall behind, DO NOT PROSCRASTINATE

Very funny professor. He is a fair grader and has helpful lectures. He gives some extra credit and curves the class some. Final is harder than the other 3 exams. Do all the past exams as practice, questions tend to be very similar. If you do all the past exams, show up to lab, and do the homework you will do well. Homework is harder than exams.

Literally the worst professor I've ever had. The way he talks to people is very rude and he tries to make excuses for it. There were so many mistakes and you'll end up having to teach yourself everything so there is no point in even attending the lectures. If you can take another prof please do and if you're forced to take him, good luck and sorry.

Lectures were not helpful at all. I did better when I stopped attending. He also provided incorrect answers for some practice problems. He occasionally also had incorrect answers on the tests. The class wasn't very difficult but I would recommend using previous practice exams to study.

Dr. Holt likes to draw visual diagrams in lectures to illustrate the concepts taught in lecture, which worked very well for me. Four exams total, there are practice exams but I never needed to do more than 2 per exam. Homework questions are HARD, but I encourage you to try to work through these questions; you will grasp the concept easier this way.
The best thing about having him was how engaging he was.  The class was not easy, though.

He was very available and explained concepts clearly in office hours, answering all my questions even rapid-fire ones. There is a good amount of homework each week, but it helps reinforce the material. His exams are slightly harder than previous years, but if you understand the content and study, you'll do fine. His lectures are fun and engaging.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Walter White, but instead of chemistry, it's physics.

I think he's really funny and I enjoy his lectures because he makes them fun. He does explain things in a really theoretical way that I didn't like but 201 is easy enough to learn on your own through the internet and textbook. It's difficult to find a fun physics prof so I commend him for that.

Going to lecture is 100% not worth it, he makes mistakes during lectures (and has many typos on every exam somehow) and makes simple topics seem complicated. The class is trivially easy once you realize the past exams are the same as the new exams, if you're a great exam taker, take Dr. Holt, if you need lectures and can't learn solo, maybe avoid.

honestly don't know how he's so unorganized. i had him for 201 and now again for 202 and every exam of his i've taken has been messed up. how hard is it to proofread your exam for errors? makes this class way harder than it needs to be. lowkey just take physics over the summer thru CC

I genuinely really liked Dr. Holt.  Physics as A&M is super difficult regardless of prof especially non-calc based as it is hard to teach and understand the algebra behind it .  I recommend Dr. Holt because he is funny and wants you to succeed (EC).  He is accessible outside of class.  Homework sucks but it does for all profs.  Attend class and SI!
Took this class last semester and I'm still thinking about how awful everything was.

I loved Holt as a person, but not so much as a professor. I learned more from asking ChatGPT questions than actually paying attention in class. Despite always complaining about people not attending class, he argued that the learning portion of this course happens outside of the classroom. PHYS is hard, especially while taking OCHEM at the same time

:(. Nathan you are not a good professor. You make too many errors to be considered even decent assistant lecture. (I already have a bachelors this is my second). Really reconsidering your field of work. Cheers!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As long as you show up to class, put in some work, give 100% for your HW, lab, and recitation, you will pass the class. Even if you bomb the tests. Prof is okay, he teaches a good foundation for concepts. Homework's are a little too elaborate, and not relevant to the tests. Definitely look over the past tests he provides. Lab was SO easy btw!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. Rude and derogatory toward students in class. He makes exams as hard as possible, and then sits back to watch the show unfold. Very arrogant with a very high view of himself, and refuses to admit when he makes massive mistakes. The only redeeming factor is that you get a ton of bonus points.

Make sure to show up to class as it counts as extra credit. HW is lengthy but allows a better understanding of the material. Plenty of practice exams that definitely helps, but try to understand the concept as wording on the exam can trip you up. Prof is very understanding and would go out his way to help explain concepts in class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Decent prof. He's very passionate about physics and has a good sense of humor. His lectures helped moderately but it's understandable because you have to put the work in by yourself  understanding the concepts of questions. His final wasn't bad at all so shoutout to him having mercy.

Probably the nicest professor I've ever come across. Make sure to go to class to get extra credit points. Exams are doable but you need a mastery of the material and not just memorizing which formulas to use if you see a certain grouping of words. Attendance at 75% gets you extra credit points which are awarded throughout the semester.

A semester of errors. The first exam was aborted midway due to a lack of printed copies. The 2nd and 3rd exams had errors in their questions that were only amended afterward. A 30-minute conversation after our 2nd exam on why an average of 64 was a great thing. It is not. Telling us it is fine is only an excuse for a failure to teach on his behalf.

Dr. Holt is smart, but he is unorganized and unprofessional. Three out of five exams were messed up my semester. The first one was omitted half way through taking it because exams were not printed in time. Exams two and three had multiple questions without correct answer choices causing lots of confusion and time delay. Overall stressful course.

this was the most unorganized prof ive had at tamu. each of our exams was riddled with errors, where the correct answer was not an option. he completely cancelled our first exam due to not printing enough copies. lecture is next to useless. if you do take him, just watch content videos online and do the practice exams
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Holt does not explain his material well in lectures, he gives new material the day of the test, and when giving his lectures, expects you to understand everything he says without him explaining it clearly. All of his tests have had errors in them, making us spend more time on certain problems that ended up not even counting. It's hilariously bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt is an amazing teacher. 10/10 lecturer and he makes it super easy to pay attention in class. However physics at A&M is not easy. But Dr. Holt has my recommendation if you choose to take physics.

Holt's exams are pretty difficult, but he gives everything you need to succeed. I would say recitation and SI helps a lot if you don't understand concepts so definitely maximize on those. Office hours almost every day + lab is super easy and never takes the full time
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt was a decent lecturer although he convolutes material in a class that's already conceptually difficult. Holt holds several office hours a week and is super responsive over GroupMe and E-mail so that's a plus. I would recommend Kelly for Phys 201 since the exams are the same across a semester no matter which prof you have.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: lots of homework and test heavy class. dont love the way he lectures, can be condescending in class if you answer wrong. not the best, not the worst

he wasn't the worst but his tests were all multiple choice no partial credit which sucks for physics. the HW is very hard, tests were easier than HW. he gave us extra credit for the FBteam winning, he is kinda funny. I wouldn't recommend going to class just study on your own and save ur time. Study every prac. test he gives.

Holt's lectures are fun and he has like eight office hours to help students. I've heard his final Qs are more difficult than others, but he adds free bonus points. I thought the homework was tedious and kind of unrelated to the exams, focus on the past exams for practice. SI & recitation helped a lot, too.

Holt is the best. Physics 201 is in general a hard and boring class, but his lectures make class interesting. Out of the other professors who write their own finals, I hear Holt's are on the tougher side. However, for the exams in the semester, he provides you with like 10 past exams so you know exactly what kinds of questions you need to study for

Make sure you go to SI or have someone to study with. As a straight A student I got a C and unfortunately didn't pick up my slack soon enough because I was under the impression reading the textbook and doing the homework and practice exams would be sufficient. It is not. Really disappointed
 :( in myself and Holt for the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt was a good prof but physics is a hard course. If you come to class, do the HW, and do the practice exams, you will do just fine. He provides exams from the past 10 years or so. The HW is way harder than the tests and takes forever. Holt gives some extra credit and curves too at the end. He makes the lectures pretty fun and interactive!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy made my semester tbh. He's super engaged with his students both in and out of lecture and is a cool guy along with being a good lecturer as well. Homework is hard, but I'm pretty sure you're getting the same homework no matter what PHYS101 prof you have. Recitation and lab didn't really help me. I studied using old practice exams and hw.

This class is a pain. The departmental homework assignments are irritating and the material is hard to grasp. Professor Holt however makes his lectures fun, the tests straightforward and is helpful during office hours. After two semesters he made me see the value in the class I hated and even made me enjoy the concepts. That takes a good teacher.
PHYS is hard no matter what. This guy is hilarious and I actually enjoyed going to class most days. Just study the past exams and you'll be fine.
Holt is a good professor, but lectures don't help much in being prepared for the exams. Doing the homework and and working on the practice exams is the way to do well in this class.

I took Holt for phys 1 and Ford for phys 2. Choose Holt. He has organized/helpful ppt slides and does practice problems during class. Exams are similar to the practice exams. Sometimes an exam will be written by another prof and will have a different style of questions so be wary. SI sessions and recitation are VERY helpful. Do the practice exams.

Holt was knowledgable but he did not fit my learning style. He did his best and showed up at 8am every time but I did not learn anything from his lectures. This class was mainly based on Mastering Physics (for this semester) and understanding directionality, so even if you stop going to lecture, it won't change much.

Holt is one of the best professors i've ever had. He makes people actually want to go to class. Be prepared to spend lots of time on homework. Not very many options for extra credit but he does tend to shift the grade cutoffs a little bit at the end of the semester

He sometimes will promise extra credit for random things and then will never give it. We asked him to solve a question from a previous exam in class and he could not solve it, and the question ended up on the exam. He will talk about real life application of physics but will not do many examples. All the PHYS 202 profs make the exams and its stupid

Came into PHYS-201 with fear, but needed it done because it was required to transfer into my major. I will be honest I am a very average student that works hards for my grades and trust me this class is completely possible. I did not find lecture very useful but its a MUST to go to your SI and Rec. Without those 2 I would not have been successful.
absolutely amazing professor. going to class is a must to get a comprehensive education and a wonderful lecture

I was very nervous to take physics at A&M and it really isn't that bad. Dr holt has great lectures, posts all previous exams, and has a ton of office hours. Homework can be annoying because they are much harder than the test questions. Do the practice exams and you're good to go.

Holt was a very good professor. All you have to do is just put the work in and you will succeed. Go to office hours, do the homework, and everything will be okay in the end. There is also enough exams to provide cushion for you if need be. I highly recommend him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Holy Roman Emperor Holt is a great professor. As someone who was nervous to take physics, he made the class very fun, engaging, and easy to understand. He uses a lot of humor in his teaching which helps me a lot! The hw is harder than the exams, don't procrastinate. Highly recommend studying the past exams he makes available. Love Noodle forever.

Dr. Holt has office hours almost every day of the week, definitely go to them! Physics is not my thing but office hours help clear everything up. Go to every lab, it's the best way to boost grades. He releases every past test until like 2015 which is very appreciated. Obviously cares about his students, would recommend! Study the hardest questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 10/10 would take again! Not going to lie the homework is awful, it's WAY harder than any exam question. He gives all the practice tests from previous years and the exams reuse questions from practice tests so DO THEM!! The exams are all multiple choice. BE SURE to check the GroupMe once in a while, sometimes there's surprises and usually fun memes!

Sensei Holt is great! He makes learning some difficult material very doable and keeps things entertaining. He is very accessible outside of class, PHYS 201 is just a tough class in general, but he is without a doubt the best person to teach you the material.

dr. holt is very accessible and puts in a lot of work to connect with and help us. he gave a very generous curve at the end of the semester and it helped a lot of us who had an off week or bad grade that didnt reflect our effort/knowledge, super caring and awesome guy :) doing practice exams and going to SI will help the most in this class!!

I went into this class hating physics due to a previous bad experience but I actually understood physics through attending Holt's lectures. He's very approachable and makes effort to connect with students. There was a good amount of homework, but it was easy to earn the points. Practicing and understanding past three years' tests helped the most.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt is a genuine and caring person but this class was needlessly difficult. The homework was extremely difficult and did not prepare you for the exams. The grade cut off for an A ended up as an 83 because our class did so poorly on the final (that he made), which is generous but at that point the stress didn't feel worth it. An empty victory.

Dr. Holt is a very entertaining during lectures and he definitely keeps you awake if you're someone likely to fall asleep during lectures. His method: presents a question, have us give him ideas on how to solve. Makes us think from the get-go. Gets us in the physics mindset early during class. VERY fair with grades and gets back to emails. Do HW!

Not good at all, but not the worst since he has office hours and easy to understand though. This guy does not know how to write tests though, expect to do way worse on his final than the common exams. It killed my grade because he had to change two questions in the middle of test since they were impossible to do with the given information.

Dr. Holt is very accessible outside of class with many office hours and a GroupMe in which he will respond to anyone almost immediately. He will curve exams if he feels they were created too hardly, and he is overall just a really fun professor to have. Explains concepts well, but just be sure to do enough practice exams and fully understand them.

I'm going to be so honest. It doesn't matter who you get for physics. I don't even go to class. Just go to SI and do the practice exams. It will be impossible to get below an A. However, Holt is funny and makes physics more bearable. I asked questions after class (when I went) and it was helpful. I just wish he did more problems from the exams.

This class sucks, the exams are the same for every prof. But, Holt's lectures are basically his own stand up comedy show and playing with toys, he doesn't teach us anything useful for the exams. Sure he's good for understanding concepts but when the class is based on the exams you basically don't know anything. Curves at the very end of the year.

He is a great professor but make sure you go to class and do the practice exams to perform well on the actual exams. There is a bunch of homework but that is the same for all physics courses, not just specifically Holt. He is accessible outside of class with a bunch of office hours, groupme, and email. Overall a great prof for a difficult class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Holt made physics easy to understand and enjoyable to come to lectures. Rely on practicing problems from class and previous exams, and the tests won't be a problem. I took the summer section, so it was fast paced, but even with Don't Panic I was able to thoroughly understand the material mainly studying lecture notes w/ a little textbook.

Dr. Holt's lectures were alright. Personally, most of the work I done was outside class depending on Tantian's lectures and the physics department tests. He was more than fair regarding grades, and he has a lot of extra credit. If you can't find Tatiana or Dowson, prof Holt will do. Overall, this course has a lot of work, and Dr. Holt was helpful.

Don't panic physics is just hard-- Dr. Holt makes it enjoyable despite that. He is extremely passionate and willing to explain/break down anything if asked even in the middle of lecture. I probably would have made an A if I had studied more effectively/taken advantage of all the resources he gave us, and I don't have a great background in physics.

Dr. Holt is a nice guy overall but consistently makes mistakes when doing problems in class and during reviews, causing widespread confusion. His writing is barely legible, especially during class, and he is overall not helpful.

Dr. Holt is a good professor, the class is very exam heavy though.  The exams are also not the kind you can just spend a few hours the night before and cram for.

Tips- keep up with studying and make sure to go to class. In my experience if you put in the time and effort to study, you'll do fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lowkey he did the minimum. He made mistakes in class in notes, (which didn't help the already difficult material). You won't get bored in his class at least, he is engaging. Overall though, prob go for a diff professor. I relied heavily on supplemental videos by tatiana and her tests.

Although he has a great personality, his lectures leave a lot to be desired. Going to Prof. Holt's lectures is very similar to the phrase "suffering from success," although you are suffering from his success. A lot of the time he just writes things down on the whiteboard without explaining, and overall class grade is made 93% up of exams.
It's impossible to see what he writes on the whiteboards, especially if you're unlucky enough to sit too far back.

Holt's lectures are great, and he is very funny. However, you will definitely need to study and practice a lot outside of class time to really understand the material. Definitely take advantage of his office hours if you need help.

I don't know where to start with Dr. Holt. I find myself loving him and disliking him at the same time. The best way I can describe him is a dad teaching physics. He has a VERY witty sense of humor and this translates BIG time into lectures. He's a decent professor. For test review, I used the supplemental materials and Tatiana's lecture video.

He is a good person but his lectures weren't that helpful, it is better to just learn through the supplemental material and recitation videos. The tests make up most of your grade, recitation is helpful but only 2% of your grade. He didn't do clicker but I anticipate that in the future he will start implementing it. Overall not a bad prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were boring, but you can just watch Tatiana's recitation videos instead since he doesn't use the clicker app to take attendance. Lots of office hours and he'll help you with any physics problems. I thought his final was fairly reasonable, nothing was too unusual and he provided an equation sheet. Overall, I thought Holt was fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: honestly, i did well in this course because of the don't panic supplemental resources & recitation TA. didn't gain much from lecture aside theory, which even then I was still lost. He is very sarcastic and funny tho. he seems to really care about this course but lecture did not help my understanding of the material. exam 3 & final were challenging.

Dr. Holt, first of his name, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, is a great teacher. Do note that his sections are Don't Panic sections, though, so his grading is very test-heavy. If you're not good at free response test questions, this might not be the instructor for you, but I'd happily take classes with him again.
